name: @vulog/create-bo-widget
description: Creates the project of a Vulog back office widget: npm create @vulog/bo-widget, with React + MUI, Svelte, Vue, Lit or plain Web Component templates.
author: Vulog

scripts.check:package: publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@vulog/create-bo-widget'); if (typeof m.createWidgetProject !== 'function' || typeof m.TEMPLATES?.vue !== 'string') throw new Error('@vulog/create-bo-widget: exports not resolved from dist');" && node dist/bin.js --version
